caseNameFull: Roberts, Receiver v. New York City
attorneys: Messrs. Carl M. Owen, Harold C. McCollom, George Welwood Murray, Charles E. Hughes, Jr., Martin A. Schenck, and Charles Franklin for petitioners. Messrs. Paxton Blair, Richard M. Page, Wm. H. Page, Joseph F. Mulqueen, Jr., Elwood Thomas, and Albert S. Wright for respondents. Mr. - Gregory Hankin also entered an appearance for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of New York granted. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
